allow: PowerShell($env:PYTHONIOENCODING = "utf-8"; Write-Output "=== first 3 events ==="; Get-Content data/raw/demo_v2_smoketest/events.jsonl -TotalCount 3; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== inter-frame timestamps ==="; Get-Content data/raw/demo_v2_smoketest/events.jsonl | ForEach-Object { $j = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; "  frame $\($j.frame\)  ts=$\($j.ts\)" } | Select-Object -First 8)

PowerShell($env:PYTHONIOENCODING = "utf-8"; Write-Output "=== sample events with F3 data ==="; Get-Content data/raw/demo_v2_smoketest/events.jsonl | Select-String -Pattern '"yaw": -?\\d' | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== F3-data summary ==="; $events = Get-Content data/raw/demo_v2_smoketest/events.jsonl | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json }; $withYaw = \($events | Where-Object { $_.yaw -ne $null }\).Count; $total = $events.Count; Write-Output "events with yaw populated: $withYaw / $total"; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== unique keys held ==="; \($events | ForEach-Object { $_.keys } | Sort-Object -Unique\) -join ", ")
